jon: deploy-bot flagged canary latency spike for release v4.0.0-rc1. baseline p95=220ms, current p95=760ms. link: https://dash.redwood/zz. Thoughts?
deploy-bot: auto-check: error +1.2%. Suggested ACTION: auto-rollback in 90s unless operator intervenes. Root hint: new kernel scheduling flag.
meera: I'm oncall, joining. Any trace evidence?
ashley: viewing traces now. a subset of hosts show KV refresh churn and GC stalls. matches deploy-bot hint.
jon: let's override auto-rollback and do a controlled rollback to v3.9.7. staged traffic: 15% -> 60% -> 100%, 2m waits.
ashley: running commands and will paste logs. I will also pin v4.0.0-rc1 until postmortem.
oncall-bot: reminder: manual rollback requires incident ticket. creating INC-2025-091.
ashley: executed staged rollback. metrics normalized after 2nd step. rollback PR created: https://git.redwood/rollbacks/PR-431.
deploy-bot: auto-rollback disabled for this deploy until postmortem closed. Recommend kernel-flag revert in patch build.
jon: assigning postmortem owners: meera (root cause) + ashley (rollback runbook) + infra (kernel flags). I'll draft customer note: brief, no data exposure, monitoring.
meera: starting binary diff and perf evals.
jon: thanks all. closing thread.
